dataIdInfo.idPurp: Extract named feature types with SAM3, find similar imagery with embeddings, and classify supplied or extracted target features using classes supplied in an example-point field.
dataIdInfo.idAbs: Feature Extraction creates features from imagery using a built-in feature type or custom SAM3 prompt. Embedding Similarity finds imagery that resembles representative points. Feature Classification uses supplied target polygons or SAM3-extracted features, then assigns each target the class with the strongest overlapping similarity evidence. Each class requires at least six representative example points.
